title: Density rhythm and column interaction overhaul for high-density virtual tables
creator: Ava Patel
description: Problem: Large, dense datasets reveal awkward visual rhythm and jarring reflows when users resize columns or toggle density modes in virtualized tables. Current behaviors cause accessibility readout noise for screen readers and inconsistent row-heights across breakpoints. Goal: Define a consistent "density rhythm" (row-height scale, vertical spacing, and typography scaling) and refine column interactions so resize, column show/hide, and density toggles feel smooth under continuous virtualization. Scope: tokens, table component, resize handles, keyboard interactions, ARIA labels, motion presets, and unit tests for layout stability. Out of scope: server-side pagination UX and new column-grouping visuals.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Row-height scale defined as tokens (compact / regular / relaxed) with explicit px values and token names
A2: Column resize uses staged manual commit: live-preview on pointer move with throttled layout updates, commit on pointer up, and keyboard incremental resize with 8px steps
A3: Virtualization maintains visual stability: no row-height jumps during density or column changes in 95th percentile of test data (100k rows)
A4: Screen reader announces column header changes once per action (no repeated verbosity during drag)
A5: Figma component kit updated and QA checklist for engineering handoff included
comments: 2025-03-02 — Ava Patel: Kickoff: ran quick audit of table stories across product. Noted inconsistent row-heights between Alerts and Logs apps; prototype directions in Figma created.

2025-03-04 — Liam O'Connor: Met with infra eng (Sophia) to review virtualization constraints. Key trade-off: live DOM updates on pointer move cause GPU thrash on 2 of 3 supported nodes. Plan: throttle live preview and commit on pointer up.
2025-03-06 — Emma Ruiz (PM): Confirmed product priorities; Logs and Console want compact default for dense listings. Flagged metrics dashboard for performance regression gating.
2025-03-07 — Accessibility review (Nina): Recommend reduced motion option for resize previews and ARIA-live strategy to coalesce messages.
2025-03-09 — Design review: settled on 3 density tokens (density.compact=28px, density.standard=36px, density.spacious=48px). Created motion token 'motion.resize-throttle=40ms'.
2025-03-10 — Engineering feedback (Sophia): Will implement virtualization guard to prevent re-measuring row heights mid-drag. Need explicit spec for keyboard resize steps and focus handling.
notes: Design decisions prioritized perceived stability over micro-interaction smoothness for low-end GPUs. We will ship with throttled live-preview and an option to opt-in to 'high-fidelity live resize' behind a feature flag for Dedicated customers.
test_plan: Visual regression suite with Storybook snapshots across densities and column widths; perf harness simulating 100k-row scroll+resize; accessibility audit with VoiceOver and NVDA; checklist for engineers to validate token integration and Figma-to-code parity.
